name: Workbench Action Menu
description: Projects a Workbench action-entry model into consistent dropdown and context-menu presentations.

states: Open the Project section add menu and inspect its command icons, disabled treatment, and grouping.
Open a Project or Workspace ellipsis menu and inspect its icon, grouping, destructive action, and submenu states.
Right-click the same owner row and confirm that the context menu projects the identical action model.
Right-click a terminal viewport and inspect its icon-bearing terminal and split commands.

useWhen: A Workbench dropdown or context menu presents an ordered set of icon-bearing command entries.
A Workbench action set must be reachable from both an ellipsis trigger and the owning object's context menu.
Menu entries already carry semantic icons, availability, grouping, and prepared action invocation.
avoidWhen: The surface is a generic menu primitive with no Workbench action-entry model.
The interaction is a single visible button and does not need disclosure or contextual invocation.
invariants: Every projection preserves the action model's entry order, grouping, availability, icon, and invocation.
When the same action model has dropdown and context-menu triggers, both projections remain identical.
Moving the pointer into an open menu keeps the owning row and trigger in their open interaction state.
Every command entry has a semantic leading icon and destructive entries use the shared danger treatment.
A contextual command can derive a confirmation anchor from its pointer position or keyboard-selected menu item.
